items.title: Nota Groep listed by Inc Ransom
items.summary: A leak-site tracker added the Dutch transportation-sector firm Nota Groep as a victim on Nov 10, 2026. The listing attributes it to Inc Ransom and the company has not confirmed the attack.

items.title: n0n group posts anonymized U.S. victims
items.summary: The n0n group listed at least two U.S. organizations on Nov 9, 2026 under placeholder names (Company #188 and #196), which suggests it is still negotiating before naming them.

items.title: Q3 2026 victim claims up 23% quarter on quarter
items.summary: Leak sites recorded 2,865 ransomware victim claims in Q3 2026, up from 2,325 in Q2. Bitdefender counted 790 claimed victims in September alone.

ransomware.note: Searches found few well-sourced named victims for November 2026. The listings come from leak-site trackers and the victims have not confirmed them.

items.title: Cloudflare Workers & Pages build errors
items.summary: On Nov 3, 2026, an outage aggregator logged a Cloudflare incident in which Workers and Pages builds failed. It was the most recent hyperscaler-adjacent incident the searches found this month.

items.title: Google Cloud europe-west2-b (London) power failure
items.summary: Reported Oct 20, 2026: a third-party facility hosting the London zone lost utility power, and a controller fault stopped the backup generators from taking over. The secondary source has not been checked against Google's status history.

items.title: H1 2026 reliability report: 30,246 cloud/SaaS outages
items.summary: IncidentHub counted 30,246 outages across the providers it tracks in the first half of 2026. It names concentrated dependency on a few providers as the main resilience risk, a concern sharpened by the EU naming AWS and Azure critical ICT third-party providers under DORA.

outage.note: No major AWS, Azure or Google Cloud outage was reported in the past two weeks. These items are older or lower-impact context.

items.title: CISA adds six exploited flaws to KEV (Nov 10)
items.summary: CISA added six actively exploited vulnerabilities covering Microsoft Outlook, Google Chrome, Barracuda appliances, Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave Webtop.

items.title: CISA KEV: GPUStack, FreeSWITCH, OpenSSH, IBM Aspera Faspex
items.summary: Four vulnerabilities were added on Nov 9 after active exploitation was confirmed. Federal agencies had until Nov 12 to remediate and complete forensic triage.

items.title: CISA warns Node2Shell flaw now exploited
items.summary: CISA warned that attackers are exploiting the critical Node2Shell vulnerability and urged organizations to patch now.

items.title: Ivanti Connect Secure zero-days hit KEV deadline
items.summary: CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527 were added to Ivanti's advisory on Oct 29. The federal KEV remediation deadline was Nov 13, so unpatched VPN appliances are now overdue.

items.title: Apple CVE-2024-27834 added to KEV as APT29 targets old iPhones
items.summary: A nation-state campaign attributed to APT29 is exploiting an older Apple WebKit flaw on unpatched iPhones. The federal due date is Nov 18.

items.title: Zyxel GS1900 zero-day used to hijack 996 switches
items.summary: Attackers used CVE-2026-107441 to take over nearly a thousand Zyxel GS1900 switches. Fixed firmware was released Oct 22.

items.title: M 6.4 — 30 km WSW of Lata, Solomon Islands
items.summary: A magnitude 6.4 earthquake struck the Santa Cruz Islands on Nov 09. USGS gave it a green alert and issued no tsunami warning.

items.title: Cyclone Murasu makes landfall in Andhra Pradesh
items.summary: Cyclone Murasu came ashore on India's Andhra Pradesh coast on Nov 3, the second cyclone to make landfall there in under a week.

items.title: Brazil declares emergencies in 44 municipalities
items.summary: Brazil's National Civil Defense recognized emergencies across 13 states on Nov 3. Santa Catarina logged 671 storm incidents in 76 municipalities on Nov 4–5.

items.title: Ecuador flooding: 12 dead, 56,000 affected
items.summary: Heavy rain and flooding in Ecuador have killed 12 people and affected 56,323, according to PAHO's early-November hazard monitoring.

items.title: Northern Mexico storms
items.summary: Weekend rainfall across four northern Mexican states killed two people, damaged 450 homes and required 45 rescues.

physical.note: Searches found no significant November 2026 wildfire reports.
